specification.boundary_rule: half-open longitude intervals modulo 360; preserve Selk first
buffer_rule: exclude non-Selk centers below threshold from any observed Selk center
exclude remaining validation centers below threshold from original test centers
exclude remaining training centers below threshold from original validation or test centers
equality at threshold is retained; excluded tiles never change active role
specification.earth_transfer: out of scope; source curation remains separate

encoders.identity_record: exact revision and weights SHA256, consistent across all folds
encoders.weights_rule: pretrained checkpoints required except the declared random_init control; no placeholders

specification.evaluation_scope: Titan geographic evaluation; no independent-crater claim

execution.cache_rule: exact catalog and split hashes, complete tile IDs and labels, normalization and encoder identity

normalization.empty_sample: reject before feature extraction; do not use the dataset's empty-sample fallback
normalization.fallback: range [0,255] permitted for a nonempty sample with percentile span below 1e-6; record its use
normalization.record: training IDs, sampling IDs, sample hash, bounds and fallback per fold
normalization.sample_integrity: reject missing sampled tile files or sampled tiles with no usable pixels
normalization.scaling: linear DN to unit interval, denominator epsilon 1e-8, clip
normalization.selection: without replacement from catalog training order, finite positive pixels

probe.checkpoint: final epoch; no validation or test selection
probe.class_weights: inverse retained training frequency, normalized to mean one
probe.features: frozen encoder outputs; no fitted feature transform

specification.prospective_constraint: geometry and budgets fixed before this evaluation's model outcomes

reporting.aggregation: mean over five head seeds per fold, then equal fold mean and sample SD
reporting.classes: all six; retain per-fold support and confusion counts
reporting.interpretation: descriptive fold variation; no independent-replicate confidence interval
reporting.metrics: macro precision, recall and F1 from six-class confusion counts

specification.role_rule: test sector f; validation sector (f+1)%5; train remaining three

specification_digest_format: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators
status: predeclared scientific protocol; frozen results verified separately
